Expense Tracker is designed to be a safe and private app. All your financial data is stored locally on your phone.\n\nNo data is sent outside of your phone unless you explicitly enable Cloud Sync. Even then, your data is stored only on your own private Google Sheet — there are no intermediate servers.
Expense Tracker is built to keep your financial data on your device. Here is exactly what happens to it.
Everything you record in Expense Tracker—your income, expenses, and categories—is stored securely on your device\'s internal database. We do not have access to this data.
We do not operate any backend servers. Your financial profile is not uploaded to any cloud service by us. Your data belongs to you and remains under your exclusive control.

If you choose to enable Google Sheets Sync, your data is sent directly from your phone to your personal Google Sheet using the URL and API key you provide. This process is fully transparent, and no third-party (including the app developers) can intercept or view your records.

The app requests permission to read SMS and Notifications only to detect transaction alerts. This processing happens locally on your device. We do not read personal chats, contact names, or any non-financial information.
We do not sell, trade, or share your data with advertisers or any third-party companies. Since we don\'t collect your data, there is nothing for us to monetize.
Your personal financial companion. Track expenses, manage budgets, and stay on top of your money.
To automatically log your expenses, Expense Tracker needs to read incoming transaction SMS from your bank.
Why is this needed?\nThis allows the app to detect and categorize your spending in real-time without manual entry.
Apps like Google Messages use RCS (Rich Communication Services) which standard SMS apps cannot read. To track these, Expense Tracker needs Notification Access.
Privacy Note:\nExpense Tracker only reads notifications from bank senders to extract transaction data. We do not collect or store your personal chats or any other data.
Granting location permission allows the app to tag where each transaction happened.
Why is this needed?\nHelpful for visualizing your spending patterns on a map and remembering where you spent your money.
Enable notifications to receive alerts about your budget limits and daily summaries.
Why is this needed?\nKeeping you informed helps you stay within your monthly budget goals.
To ensure no transaction is missed, Expense Tracker needs to run its monitoring service in the background.
Why is this needed?\nAndroid may stop the app if not allowed in background, which would stop automatic tracking. We also recommend disabling battery optimization for Expense Tracker.

Securely backup and sync your data with Google Sheets (Setup in Settings).

Cloud Sync offers powerful features while keeping you in full control:

• Automatic Backup: Never lose your data.
• Multi-device Access: View your data on any device via Google Sheets.
• Custom Analysis: Use Google Sheets tools to create your own reports.
• Privacy: Your data goes directly from your phone to your Google Sheet.
You can always change this later in Settings.
1. Create a new Google Sheet and copy its URL.
2. Paste the Sheet URL in the box below.
3. Click \"Copy Code\" to copy the Apps Script code.
4. In your Google Sheet, go to Extensions -> Apps Script.
5. Delete any existing code, paste the copied code, and Save (Ctrl+S).
6. Click \"Generate API Key\" below, copy it.
7. In Apps Script, go to Project Settings (gear icon) -> Script Properties -> Add Property.
8. Property: API_KEY, Value: [Paste your generated key] -> Save Properties.
9. Click Deploy -> New Deployment -> Select Type: Web App.
10. Description: \"Expense Tracker\", Execute as: Me, Who has access: Anyone -> Deploy.
11. Copy the \"Web App URL\" and paste it into the Script URL box below.
